Shaik ShoiabOwner, Demand Footware

Three decades on Jamal Market Road

My father started selling slippers from a small counter in Chatta Bazar in 1994. I used to sit beside him after school, counting pairs and tying sets with plastic string. That is where I learned that a retailer remembers one thing: did the stock sell or did it sit.

So we make and pick articles that sell. Soles that do not crack in the first monsoon, straps that hold, colours shopkeepers in the districts keep asking for. Retailers who bought from my father now send their sons to buy from me.

  • We manufacture and supply, so you buy at wholesale rate without a middleman.
  • Every set is assorted in sizes 6 to 9 and mixed colours.
  • Open six days a week until 10 PM, so you can finish market rounds and still reach us.
  • Supply across Telangana, sent with the transport you already use.
  • Wholesale only. No retail walk-ins, so stock stays ready for your order.
